name: [Negative] Cashback Not Usable for Recharge and Bill Payments
description: Users are unable to use earned cashback for bill payments and recharges, citing changes in terms and conditions.

name: [Negative] Cashback Redemption Issues
description: Multiple users reported difficulties in redeeming cashback rewards, which were often rendered unusable for bill payments or recharge, citing opaque or misleading cashback systems.

name: [Negative] Cashback Not Usable for Bill Payments
description: Users are unable to apply the cashback they earn from bill payments or recharges to future bill or recharge transactions, as the app now restricts redemption exclusively to US stock purchases and has removed the option altogether.

name: [Negative] Cashback Not Usable for Bill Payments
description: Users consistently report that cashback earned from bill payments is not redeemable for bill payments or recharges, instead it is redirected to US stocks investments or locked in a separate rewards account. This misalignment between promised cashback utility and actual redemption options causes confusion, dissatisfaction, and perceived fraud.
